implementation_strategy: Execute preregistered paired protocol using the hosted_netops_gvr_v1 adapter: per-task single shared initial generation (baseline+guarded share initial candidate semantics), deterministic syntax and policy validators applied automatically, up to one automated repair call in guarded condition when validator fails. Freeze model identifier at run start (gpt-5-mini), record per-call SHA-256 hashes, timestamps, and validator predicates. Primary analysis uses paired_binary_analysis_v1 on complete pairs; missing/failed calls logged and handled per preregistration. All scoring and flagging deterministic and adapter-native; no human labour.
public_resources: Emulated NetOps generate→validate→repair testbed v1 (preregistered task list and deterministic oracle)
Validators and repair prompt families published with cryptographic hashes
model_and_version_plan: gpt-5-mini (frozen at experiment start; model id and provider endpoint recorded in execution manifest)
task_manifest_strategy: Use preregistered 200-task manifest stratified by protocol/vendor/complexity; publish manifest and per-task hashes prior to execution.
transformation_manifest_strategy: Publish deterministic validator rule-sets and repair-prompt family (generate_validate_repair_v1) with SHA-256 hashes; validators are deterministic parsers and predicate checkers executed in CPU containers.
randomisation_plan: Task ordering randomized within each batch using a fixed pseudorandom seed; stratification preserved per preregistration.
caching_plan: Prompt and output artifacts cached with SHA-256; identical repeated calls avoided by deterministic hashing; cache used only for retrieval of previously recorded artifacts (no reuse to alter scientific outcomes).
failure_recovery_plan: Adapter-native automatic retries only for transient provider/network errors per adapter limits; pairs with provider/model-id drift are flagged 'provider-drift-affected' and excluded from primary analysis; all infra failures logged.
result_schema: paired_binary_episode_v1 (deterministic oracle pass/fail flags per episode, validator predicates exercised, repair-iteration counts, per-call hashes, timestamps)
estimated_compute_notes: All emulation and deterministic validators run on CPU; hosted model API (gpt-5-mini) used for generation/repair. Total model calls bounded to 400 (200 tasks × up to 2 calls). Wall-clock within 7 days expected given adapter rate limits.
